name: @quantskills/dsh-plugin
description: QuantStudio local AI workspace for quantitative research and everyday work, with an integrated pinned DSH runtime

scripts.uninstall:plugin: dsh plugin --profile web remove @quantskills/dsh-plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-team @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-agent-team @deepseek-ai/dsh-quantskills-host @deepseek-ai/dsh-quantskills-session @deepseek-ai/dsh-panda-mcp @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-remotes-quantskills dsh-file-upload @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-quantskills dshmarket
scripts.typecheck:portable: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir packages/agent-team run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-layout run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-input-trigger run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-conversation run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-chat run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/client-remotes-quantskills run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/panda-connector run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/panda-mcp run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/quantskills-host run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/quantskills-session run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/tool-agent-team run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/ui-quantskills run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run verify:source && pnpm run typecheck:portable
scripts.build:types:host: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/agent-team exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-remotes-quantskills exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/panda-connector exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/panda-mcp exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/quantskills-host exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/quantskills-session exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/tool-agent-team exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:host: pnpm run build:types:host && node scripts/generate-session-remotes.mjs && pnpm exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts
scripts.build:client: pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-layout exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-layout exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-conversation exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-conversation exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-input-trigger exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-input-trigger exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-chat exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-ui-chat exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && pnpm --dir packages/client-remotes-quantskills exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/client-remotes-quantskills exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && pnpm --dir packages/ui-quantskills exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/ui-quantskills exec tsdown --config tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && node ./scripts/normalize-client-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.pack:plugin: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm pack --pack-destination ./release
